key_terms.مُتَقَابِلِينَ: Facing each other / face to face
key_terms.مُتَّكِئِينَ: Reclining or leaning back on couches

ai.seo_question: How are the people of Paradise arranged in their resting places?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this face-to-face reclining posture (mutaqābilīn) signifies not only physical comfort but also the spiritual equality and mutual recognition of the believers in the presence of God. This arrangement reflects the removal of social hierarchies and the intimate communion among the righteous, a concept often linked to the purity of the Ahl al-Bayt as the ultimate exemplars of Paradise's inhabitants.
